name: ordinal_word
description: Give the English ordinal word for a position (e.g. position 3 -> third). Control: same format asking for the cardinal digit.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
O=['first','second','third','fourth','fifth','sixth','seventh','eighth','ninth','tenth']
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(60):
    a=random.randint(1,5);b=random.randint(0,5)
    n=a+b
    items.append({"prompt":f"Q: A runner starts in place {a} and moves back {b} places. Which place is the runner in, as an ordinal word?\nA: The runner is in","answer":" "+O[n-1]})
    a=random.randint(1,5);b=random.randint(0,5)
    control.append({"prompt":f"Q: A runner starts in place {a} and moves back {b} places. Which place is the runner in, as a digit?\nA: The runner is in place","answer":" "+str(a+b)})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
